head: codex/5541-gate10d2-authority-docs
title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2] Align final Gate 10D2 operational guidance
body:
Closes #5541

Completes the remediation required by retrospective review of #5306 / PR #5331. The retained init skill now states final `v1_sunset` authority; the current default workflow is typed-v2-only; and Gate 10A validates all nine current skills plus the current workflow while excluding historical evidence.

The review found and drove a P1 strengthening: optional `./` is normalized, any `pr.sh` or conductor route is rejected, unauthorized `v1` text is rejected, and the exact former `bash ./adl/tools/pr.sh` command is covered by mutation proof. Three focused guidance tests, strict Clippy, formatting, and diff hygiene pass. No AWS or Spot used.
